# EUDRSearch

EUDRSearch is an independent website for EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) product screening and compliance preparation.

## Core tools
- https://eudrsearch.com/eudr-checker/ — combined product, country-risk, company-size and timing checker
- https://eudrsearch.com/cn-code/ — EUDR CN-code reference pages
- https://eudrsearch.com/hs-code/ — HS vs CN classification guide
- https://eudrsearch.com/country-risk/ — EUDR country benchmarking checker
- https://eudrsearch.com/due-diligence/ — due-diligence workflow
- https://eudrsearch.com/geolocation/ — geolocation guidance
- https://eudrsearch.com/dds/ — due-diligence statement guide
- https://eudrsearch.com/deadlines/ — application dates

## Reference hubs
- https://eudrsearch.com/products/
- https://eudrsearch.com/countries/
- https://eudrsearch.com/faq/
- https://eudrsearch.com/sources/
- https://eudrsearch.com/about/

## Primary official sources
- European Commission EUDR overview: https://environment.ec.europa.eu/topics/forests/deforestation/regulation-deforestation-free-products_en
- Regulation (EU) 2023/1115: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2023/1115/oj
- Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2026/2102/oj
- Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1093: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/1093/oj

EUDRSearch is informational and independent. It is not an EU institution and does not provide legal advice.
